impact_narrative: Checkout is fully down while pods crash-loop, blocking roughly 1,200 purchase attempts per minute.
cause_summary: Commit d4e5f6a7b8 changed db_pool_timeout from 30 to '30s' in config/checkout.yaml; the service parses this value as an int and exits on startup.

runbook_citation.heading_path: Deploy & Config Runbook > CrashLoopBackOff after a config rollout
runbook_citation.why: Covers rolling back a bad config change and validating YAML before rollout.

next_steps: Revert the config change (db_pool_timeout: 30) and redeploy — one-line fix.
Verify pods leave CrashLoopBackOff and checkout availability recovers.
Add schema validation for config/*.yaml in CI.
